A profile's public assets, and an asset as a post's card
Assets on the profile page with upload and publish, on the shiur page, and as a post card

acs.text: WHEN a signed-in user posts `POST /api/v1/shiurim` with a title, an optional visibility (`private`, `unlisted` the default, or `public`) and an optional `recordingId` THE SYSTEM SHALL create a shiur they own and attach the recording to it; a recording that is not theirs SHALL be 404 and no shiur created; `GET /api/v1/shiurim` SHALL list the caller's own shiurim; existing shiurim and recordings are unchanged by the migration

WHEN anyone asks `GET /api/v1/shiurim/{shiurId}` for an unlisted or public shiur THE SYSTEM SHALL answer its title, visibility, its owner's name and profile id, its ready recordings and its pinned assets in order, each asset with its pinned version, title, refs, first ref, public `contentUrl` and signed `shiurUrl` (spec 061); a private or unknown shiur SHALL be 404 there; hidden assets are left out

WHEN the shiur's owner posts `POST /api/v1/shiurim/{shiurId}/assets` with `{assetId, versionId?}` THE SYSTEM SHALL pin that version (default: the asset's current version if it is the owner's asset, its published version otherwise), or move the pin if the asset is already there; the asset must be the caller's own or published and not hidden, and only its published version may be pinned when it is not theirs; `DELETE /api/v1/shiurim/{shiurId}/assets/{assetId}` SHALL remove it; anyone else, an unknown asset or version, or a version that may not be pinned SHALL get 404
WHEN the author saves a newer version of a pinned asset THE SYSTEM SHALL keep answering the pinned version in the shiur until its owner moves the pin
scenarios: AC-004 the pin survives a newer version

acs.text: WHEN anyone asks `GET /api/v1/profiles/{profileId}/claude-assets` THE SYSTEM SHALL answer the published, not hidden assets of that person, newest first, each with id, title, description, refs, published version id and its `contentUrl`

WHEN a post is written with `embed: {kind: "asset", id}` THE SYSTEM SHALL accept it when the asset is the author's own or published, and not hidden, and answer the post's embed with the asset's title, its author's name as `leader` and its `contentUrl`; any other asset SHALL be 404 and no post created; posts with other embeds are unchanged
scenarios: AC-006 an asset as a post card

acs.text: WHEN a profile page is shown THE SYSTEM SHALL list that person's public assets, each with its title, description and an Open link to its content in a new tab; on the viewer's own page it SHALL also list their own assets with Publish or Unpublish (a refusal because the profile is not verified says so) and a file input that uploads an `.html` asset and shows the problems of a refused file; a shiur page SHALL list its pinned assets the same way; a post card with an asset embed SHALL show its title, "by" its author and an Open link, or "no longer available"
